name: medium-research-hn
description: Hacker News research with normalized MCP output. Wraps the public Algolia HN Search + Firebase APIs (hn_search, hn_top, hn_rising, hn_get). Runs fully keyless — HN needs no credentials, so there is no user_config. KNOWN GOTCHA (Claude Code plugin path): a bundled server can silently fail to spawn — if it does not appear, check `claude mcp list`.
